abstract: Immunohistological techniques were used to characterise inflammatory cell infiltrates in mixed germ cell tumours. The distribution of these infiltrates was much more variable than in pure seminomas but could not be related accurately to any particular tumour type. There were approximately equal numbers of B and T cells in these areas and helper/inducer T cells were more common than suppressor/cytotoxic lymphocytes. Within these areas of inflammatory cells, the subtype composition was similar to that seen in pure seminomas.
abstract_ja: 混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における炎症性細胞浸潤を、免疫組織学的手法を用いて解析した。浸潤細胞の分布は純粋なセミノーマに比べかなり多様であったが、特定の腫瘍型との正確な対応は認められなかった。炎症細胞領域のB細胞とT細胞の数はほぼ同等であり、ヘルパー/誘導性T細胞は抑制性/細胞傷害性リンパ球よりも多かった。これらの炎症細胞領域内のサブタイプ構成は、純粋なセミノーマで見られるものと類似していた。
